details:
Persona is in fact, linked to Palantir. 

This is the same controversy discord is having currently with it's verification.

Persona is currently in several disputes regarding maintaining user data longer than it's privacy clause dictates due to said involvement with palantir.

Palantir is pushing for a surveillance state that puts minority groups at risk.

Palantir Is not something VRC should want to be associated with.
title: Find an Age Verification Provider Not Linked to Palantir
